appearance_facts.location: Bar for May (far right of x-axis)
appearance_facts.fact: The May bar is the shortest mark on the chart; its top edge is just above the x-axis baseline, well below the 10,000 gridline.
The Jun bar is the second shortest mark; its top edge is between the 15,000 and 20,000 gridlines.
The Feb bar is taller than the Jun bar; its top edge aligns with the 20,000 gridline.
The Mar bar is taller than the Feb bar; its top edge is between the 25,000 and 30,000 gridlines.
The Apr bar is taller than the Mar bar; its top edge is just below the 30,000 gridline.
The Jan bar is the tallest mark on the chart; its top edge aligns with the 40,000 gridline.
All six bars share the same dark red fill color.
